summary: Under restoration and mixed restoration–conservation commitments, Honduras’s updated target is to conserve and functionally restore 1.3 million hectares of rural forest landscape by 2030. The NDC also cites a 1-million-hectare Bonn Challenge forest-restoration commitment and proposes 300,000 additional hectares of nature-based restoration, conditional on climate finance. Sustainable agroforestry is the agriculture-related measure, but no numerical agricultural area is stated. For perspective, against 2022 forest cover of 81,019 km², the 1.3-million, 1-million and 300,000-hectare figures are equivalent to approximately 16.0%, 12.3% and 3.7% of current forest cover, respectively. Conservation commitments additionally seek a 50% reduction in average annual gross deforestation in eight prioritized clusters, a 39% reduction in household firewood consumption by 2030, and a 1% LULUCF-sector emissions reduction relative to projected 2030 emissions, conditional on climate finance.
